 The poem was transcribed in Mary Copybk 2 (Massey 76–7) under the heading ‘A Song’
and published under that title in the ‘Miscellaneous Poems’ section of 1824, apparently
indicating that Mary was unaware of its destination in Charles the First immediately prior
